title: QuTracer: Mitigating Quantum Gate and Measurement Errors by Tracing Subsets of Qubits
problem: Gate and measurement errors in NISQ quantum circuits reduce output fidelity, and prior measurement subsetting approaches like Jigsaw fail to mitigate gate errors.
motivation: Effective error mitigation is essential for achieving practical quantum advantage with near-term noisy quantum devices.
method: QuTracer uses qubit subsetting Pauli checks (QSPC) combining circuit cutting and Pauli Check Sandwiching to trace qubit subset distributions throughout computation. It executes multiple circuit copies each measuring different qubit subsets to obtain localized distributions with reduced crosstalk, then aggregates these to refine the global output distribution.
key_novelty: Extending measurement subsetting to simultaneously mitigate both gate and measurement errors through circuit cutting and Pauli checking techniques.
contributions: QuTracer framework for mitigating both gate and measurement errors in quantum circuits
Qubit subsetting Pauli checks (QSPC) technique using circuit cutting and Pauli Check Sandwiching
Demonstration of applicability across multiple quantum algorithms including VQE, QAOA, and QPE
Experimental validation showing improved fidelity over Jigsaw on both simulated and real quantum devices

metrics.accuracy: improved output fidelity over state-of-the-art error mitigation approaches

limitations: Computational overhead and scalability limits of running multiple circuit copies not discussed.
primary_theme: quantum error mitigation via subset tracing
